prompts.plaza: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original Japanese fantasy visual novel background, wide 16:9. An intimate medieval European inspired village square at early evening, natural stone paving, timber and pale plaster cottages with terracotta roofs, a central low round stone well to one side, small market carts with colourful fabric awnings, warm lanterns just turning on. A small group of three generic travelling musicians with a bowed string instrument and wooden flute sit far to the left edge, and a few indistinct adult villagers watch from the background. Leave the central stone-paved space open for a couple to dance; do NOT depict the protagonists or any recognisable characters. Charming everyday village atmosphere, lively but not a grand festival, no castle, no star whale. Detailed hand-painted anime game environment, gentle atmospheric light, warm honey amber against soft violet dusk, refined natural proportions and rich textures. Clean environment illustration, not a UI, no words, labels or watermark.
prompts.hill: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original Japanese fantasy visual novel background, wide 16:9. View from a gentle grassy hillside behind a small old village watermill overlooking a cosy medieval European inspired village in a valley at blue hour just after sunset. Foreground: a broad, safe, mostly level patch of short soft grass where two people could slowly dance, tiny wildflowers at the edge, no figures. Below: timber and pale plaster houses, terracotta roofs, a small central village square with a stone well and warm glowing lanterns, an inn near the square, fields and winding lanes. Distance: dark blue layered mountains and an untravelled valley, last pale peach light fading near the horizon, darkening indigo sky. Watermill only partly visible at far left edge below viewpoint, not blocking the vista. Romantic peaceful everyday atmosphere, not dramatic magic. Detailed polished hand-painted anime visual novel environment, soft luminous windows, coherent painterly textures. No people, no protagonists, no text, no UI, no watermark.
